name: Gerenzo's Orders
summary: At the Venture Company dig site in Stonetalon, Piznik works against his new boss, Gerenzo. The ousted goblin digs a sample to expose the ore operation while an ally guards him from patrols at the camp.

sections.title: Corporate Betrayal in the Crag
sections.body: At Windshear Crag, the Venture Company rewards ruthlessness over loyalty. Piznik once served as second-in-command at the excavation. Then Gerenzo seized power, fired supervisor Ziz Fizziks, and sent Piznik back to the mines with a pick. Yet Piznik stayed. At Ziz's instruction, he became an informant, watching Gerenzo's every move and waiting for a chance to strike back at the supervisor who displaced him.

sections.title: Unearthing the Gold-Green Vein
sections.body: Gerenzo's takeover began with an obsession: strange gold-green ore in the Stonetalon rock. He believes the mineral is worth an extraordinary sum, and ordered miners to tear it from the earth in huge quantities. Ziz Fizziks now has a mysterious employer who may pay well for news of the venture. So Piznik risks discovery to dig out a sample. An ally holds off aggressive diggers, vermin, and overseers who police the operation.

faq.answer: Piznik is a goblin laborer at the Windshear Crag operation in the Stonetalon Mountains. He once ranked second under Ziz Fizziks. Then Gerenzo seized control and demoted him to mine labor.

faq.q: Why is Piznik mining this ore secretly?
faq.answer: Piznik secretly gathers a sample of the strange gold-green ore Gerenzo ordered mined in huge quantities. His former boss, Ziz Fizziks, says a new employer will pay well for information about Gerenzo's valuable operation.

Gerenzo is the ruthless Venture Company supervisor who took control of the Stonetalon excavation by firing Ziz Fizziks. He turned company resources toward digging up unfamiliar gold-green ore found throughout the crag.

faq.q: Who does Ziz Fizziks work for now?
faq.answer: After Gerenzo fired Ziz Fizziks, Ziz allied with new backers interested in monitoring Venture Company activity in the region. Ziz pays operatives and informants like Piznik to sabotage Gerenzo and learn what the company is unearthing.

faq.q: What attacks Piznik while he digs?
faq.answer: Venture Company workers attack Piznik as he digs. They include Windshear Tunnel Rats, Windshear Vermin, diggers, geomancers, stonecutters, and overseers.

faq.q: What happens once the sample is mined?
aliases: what to do with the sample
faq.answer: After Piznik extracts the ore sample, he gives it to his protector to deliver directly to Ziz Fizziks. He hopes the sample will give Ziz leverage to thwart Gerenzo's plans.

angles.text: The strange gold-green ore found by Venture Company miners in Stonetalon matches neither iron nor tin veins. That draws the interest of prospectors curious about rare minerals.
The Venture Company's reckless, invasive mining despoils Stonetalon's natural landscape. Monitoring, disrupting, or exploiting its operations can aid Horde forces nearby.
